status: design and preregistration candidate; no online run executed
commit_roles: trajectory_source_commit freezes the 3,200 source traces; project_repository_baseline freezes the repository state researched in this report
objective: Recover complementary candidate exposure and ranking repairs without turning agreement, repeated mentions, generated prose, or destructive local pruning into clinical evidence.

collapse3c.role: structured state compiler and specificity-retention anchor
collapse3c.default_schedule: mandatory peer-blind initial exposure atom together with Forest
consumable_exports: candidate-relative support and against claims after validation

forest.default_schedule: mandatory peer-blind initial exposure atom together with Collapse3c
consumable_exports: syndrome, mechanism, and definitive-modality lane provenance

impc.role: counter-hypothesis, anchoring challenge, and error-decorrelated proposal atom
impc.default_schedule: on contradiction, unexplained decisive fact, or over-concentrated active set
consumable_exports: candidate-unique fact-bound support and against claims

multistance_residual.role: conditional residual proposal operator, not a fourth vote
multistance_residual.default_schedule: off unless a typed residual gap persists

suboperators.commit: invoke for an unresolved global synthesis or object-complete formulation gap
suboperators.coverage: invoke for a named missing ordinary, dangerous, or alternative-class candidate
suboperators.mechanism: invoke for a named causal or pathophysiologic gap

consumable_exports: candidate-relative claims that bind exactly to the shared fact manifest
non_consumable_as_evidence: a nearest or approximate fact id

exposure_gap.predicate: a required object component or clinically material alternative class is absent from the residual registry

mechanism_gap.predicate: a decisive observed fact remains unexplained by every active candidate

anchoring_or_contradiction.predicate: the anchor lacks a candidate-unique answer to an observed contradiction or active candidates share the same unsupported assumption

object_scope_gap.predicate: parent, component, manifestation, mechanism, subtype, or incomplete composite is co-ranked with the requested object

claim_binding_gap.predicate: candidate claims disagree on subject, episode, temporality, polarity, or exact source span

decision_boundary_gap.predicate: more than one maximal active candidate remains or an unresolved edge can change the maximal set
route_order: dependency-interaction audit when single-edge evidence is insufficient

selection_rule: Recompute the typed unresolved-dispute queue only from immutable inputs and appended validated events.
Order events by safety criticality, whether they can change the maximal set, expected information value, deterministic route priority, then stable event id.
Invoke at most one scheduled atom or verifier for the head event.
Append the raw result before validation; never rewrite an earlier packet.
Quarantine new labels until identity, requested-object projection, and patient-evidence binding pass.
Append only validated consumable edges to the partial-order graph.

Clinical proposal closure requires successful Collapse3c and Forest packets plus terminal accounting for every scheduled packet, proposal, binding, object, rule, and decision-relevant gap; a recorded mandatory failure invalidates closure.

Stop with a unique result only when proposal closure remains valid, at least two object-compatible candidates are frozen, and one candidate has a validated direct mirrored win over every rival; otherwise return a certified tie, abstention, or explicitly conditional active-set result when the budget ends.
routing_prohibitions: routing from reference labels or post-hoc endpoint outcomes
recursive gap generation without a declared cap

proposal_closure_contract.audit_accounting: Every scheduled packet is recorded as success, partial, or explicit failure. A mandatory failure is auditable but cannot satisfy clinical closure.
closure_requirements: both mandatory lineages succeeded peer-blind over the identical immutable input
every temporary proposal and global candidate has terminal identity, alias, object, manifest-binding, patient-evidence, and external-rule states
every identity-safe potentially object-compatible proposal is admitted unless a validated patch proves it incompatible or non-decision-relevant
missing evidence, verifier failure, and unknown status never prove non-decision relevance
requested-object components and decision-relevant exposure or mechanism gaps are closed
proposal_closure_contract.failure_behavior: Any mandatory failure or unresolved proposal/gap returns abstention or an explicitly conditional active-set result and forbids a unique clinical certificate.

comparison_and_stop_contract.partial_order: The scientific output is a validated directed acyclic graph with explicit incomparable and tied candidates; a total order is not required.
comparison_and_stop_contract.non_vacuity: The frozen active set must contain at least two object-compatible candidates. This v1 orchestration defines no exhaustive-null-alternative certificate, so a singleton returns abstention or conditional-active-set.
comparison_and_stop_contract.unique_top: A unique Top-1 is certified only when proposal closure is valid and that candidate has a validated consumable order-consistent direct mirrored greater-than edge against every other frozen active candidate; no transitive path substitutes for an untested pair.
comparison_and_stop_contract.progressive_pairing: A missing direct proposed-top-versus-rival edge, a pair whose resolution can change the maximal set, or a cycle edge is mandatory. Paths may prioritize the queue but never certify an untested pair. Full rival-rival all-pairs comparison is optional audit coverage, not the deployment prerequisite.
comparison_and_stop_contract.budget_end: Return the current maximal tie set, abstention, or explicitly conditional active-set result. Invalid proposal closure, mandatory-lineage failure, singleton active set, or an incomplete direct proposed-top star forbids a clinical unique result. A benchmark adapter may apply a stable label-blind tie-break, but must mark the choice uncertified and keep it out of clinical-complete claims.
comparison_and_stop_contract.cycle_behavior: Quarantine the newest cycle-forming edge, append a cycle event, and route the smallest deterministic disputed subset for re-verification. Never delete the older ledger state.

mechanism_research_full_visibility.purpose: Estimate proposal and edge complementarity without claiming deployability.
mechanism_research_full_visibility.phase_1: Run Forest, IMPC, Collapse3c, and the three historical MultiStance suboperators peer-blind on the same frozen input.
mechanism_research_full_visibility.aggregation: Export all pre-selector packets; do not expose peer outputs to any atom and do not consume local champions as votes.
primary_estimands: new identity-safe exposure per incremental atom
shared-candidate rank repair per incremental atom

deployment_adaptive.purpose: Minimize calls while preserving verifiable complementarity.
deployment_adaptive.mandatory_initial_behavior: Run peer-blind on identical immutable input; either failure invalidates clinical proposal closure even though the failure packet remains auditable.
deployment_adaptive.primary_stop: valid proposal closure plus direct mirrored proposed-top star; otherwise stable maximal tie set, abstention, or conditional-active-set
deployment_adaptive.claim_status: hypothesis requiring prospective comparison against fixed schedules

required_ablations: fixed Collapse3c only versus GAVE-MAS with identical endpoint and source cases
all four historical pipelines versus gated atom schedule at matched call budget
MultiStance historical tournament versus pre-tournament residual export
full commit-times-three versus full commit-plus-coverage-plus-mechanism at identical calls and token budget; a single second-commit replicate is only a repeat-variance diagnostic
pre-registered commit, coverage, and mechanism marginal ablations or a two-to-the-third factorial to identify main and interaction effects
stance/group counts visible versus blinded to the global comparator
full all-pairs comparison versus progressive decision-boundary certification
majority vote versus validated-edge aggregation, reported only as a safety diagnostic
typed trigger router versus fixed schedule, with router training and evaluation separated by case
identity/object/evidence gates removed one at a time
clinical-complete, compatible partial, exposure, conversion, reliability, abstention, and calls reported separately

current_evidence_bounds.historical_triad_complete_oracle: 155/800 versus best single 122/800; upper bound only
current_evidence_bounds.historical_four_atom_complete_oracle: 165/800 versus best single 122/800; adding MultiStance contributes 10 oracle cases
current_evidence_bounds.multistance_cost: 5.1725 mean calls versus Collapse3c 3.2775; the four historical arms total 16.51125 mean calls
current_evidence_bounds.multistance_nature_of_increment: Among 10 MultiStance-only complete cases, normalized correct-label presence in a triad pool separates six likely comparison/scope opportunities from four observed-label exposure additions; this label-only diagnostic is not a clinical pool adjudication.
current_evidence_bounds.routing_limit: Existing static specialization signals are not strong enough to justify a learned deployment router; the proposed typed router remains unvalidated.

forbidden_claims: The historical four-atom oracle is an attainable MAS result.
Agreement or repetition is evidence strength.
Adaptive routing is superior before a prospective matched-budget test.
A deterministic benchmark tie-break is a clinically certified unique diagnosis.
An external medical rule is an observed patient fact.
